Ted Mitch Agent

Your picks, tracked live. Automatically.

Ted Mitch Agent is our own bot inside the Discord. It follows every pick against live NBA box scores and posts the moment a prop hits or a slip settles, so you are never refreshing an app wondering.

  • 📡
    Live prop trackingChecks live box scores about every 90 seconds while games are on, and watches each pick against its line.
  • ✅
    Instant prop-hit alertsWhen a prop clears its line, a hit card with the final number lands in the channel.
  • 🎟️
    Slip cards, leg by legEvery slip is shown with each leg marked WON, LOST or PENDING, and posted the moment it settles.
  • 📊
    Nightly recap and honest recordsDaily, weekly and monthly records with hit rate, every result included, wins and losses.

Frequently asked questions

Are results guaranteed?

No. No pick guarantees a win and sports betting involves risk. Only stake what you can afford to lose, and always bet responsibly.

I’m new. Is this for me?

Yes. Every pick explains why it was chosen, and the guides cover bankroll and unit basics from day one.

Is this available in my country?

You can read our analysis anywhere. The platforms where picks are played have their own country and state rules, so check yours before you play.

What is the Ladder Challenge?

A day-by-day challenge where we start small and aim for a target each day. The plays are posted as a graphic, and it is open to every user.

Which platforms do the picks cover?

Our slips are played on PrizePicks. If you want to know about another platform, ask in the Discord and we will tell you.

How do I cancel?

You can manage or cancel your plan from your Winible account at any time, or message us in the Discord and we will point you to the right place.

Play smart, stay in control

Picks are analysis, never a promise. These habits keep it fun.

Set a limit first

Decide your budget before you play and stop when you reach it.

Only what you can lose

Never stake money you need for bills, rent or savings.

Know your local rules

Betting and DFS platforms are not legal or available everywhere. Check the rules where you live and play only if you are of legal age.

Need help? US: 1-800-GAMBLER. UK: GamCare, 0808 8020 133. Elsewhere, search for your country’s gambling support line.
